[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Surprise Box[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]A mystery box that gives you a random object a day, you could have the luck of your life or you could get trash, literally.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Pierre's store you can buy this box that gives you a random item per day from all the items available in the game, with some exceptions. The box can also give you any item from any Mod you currently have installed. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[color=#ff0000][size=5]Its operation is simple and does not have much mystery, other than not knowing what you can get. I hope you enjoy it![/size][/color]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
